summary: CIBC filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an updated Code of Conduct (Exhibit 99.1), approved by the board and effective November 2026, alongside a message from President and CEO Harry Culham. No transaction, ownership stake, price, premium, advisor, or closing date is disclosed. The exhibit is an internal governance and ethics framework covering conflicts, financial crime, privacy, AI use, and outside activities. No structural or regulatory mechanics apply. Nothing here constitutes a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle exist.
